violations.text: Raw animal foods (eggs) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (fruit, and cheese) in the prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Food items were moved during time of inspection. Establishment moved eggs to bottom shelf of prep unit during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 07/13/2026

The establishment does not employ a full-time, on-site manager certified in food safety at all times when time temperature control for safety (TCS) food is being prepared, handled, and/or served. No employee present was a Food Safety Manager. Establishment must train additional employees as a food safety manager. New Violation. Correct By: 08/25/2026

The hand-washing sink in the kitchen was blocked by a strainer. A hand-washing sink shall be accessible at all times for employee use. Strainer was moved to three bay sink during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

Raw animal foods (egg and hamburgers) were observed stored above ready-to-eat foods (fruit, and cheese) in the prep unit. Raw animal foods must be separated from raw ready-to-eat food such as vegetables during storage. Food items were moved during time of inspection. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

Pooled eggs was observed held at 78 degrees Fahrenheit. Time/temperature control for safety (TCS) food must be held at 41 degrees Fahrenheit or below except during preparation, cooking, or cooling. Pooled eggs were voluntarily disposed of. Corrected On-Site. New Violation. Correct By: 06/25/2026

The establishment is lacking a thermometer to test food temperatures. Food temperature measuring devices shall be provided and be readily accessible for checking cooking, cooling, reheating, and hot/cold holding temperatures of time/temperature control for safety (TCS) foods. Establishment is to obtain a probe thermometer. New Violation. Correct By: 06/26/2026

The cutting boards in the kitchen are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 03/27/2025
The ceiling tiles in the dinning area is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 04/20/2025

The cutting boards in the prep unit are very scratched and scored. Cutting blocks and boards that are subject to scratching and scoring shall be resurfaced if they can no longer be effectively cleaned and sanitized, or discarded if they are not capable of being resurfaced. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024
The prep table located in the kitchen area was not in good repair. Equipment must be in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/19/2024

The dumpster outside is located on an absorbent material. The outdoor storage surface for refuse, recyclables, and returnable must be constructed of nonabsorbent material such as concrete or asphalt and must be smooth, durable, and sloped to drain. Establishment is to move dumpster to the nonabsorbent surface of parking lot. New Violation. Correct By: 03/12/2025
The floor in the walk-in cooler is in poor repair. The physical facilities must be maintained in good repair. New Violation. Correct By: 12/12/2025
